The small, slight chibi girl with dark brown skin shown in <Picture 1> appears exactly as in <Picture 1>, in the same pose and full-body framing, preserving her spiky black thorn halo floating above her head, her messy black hair covering her right eye, her single red eye and bandaged forehead, her small pointy teeth when she opens her mouth, her tall-collared black coat with belts and buckles, her bandaged shin and her chunky black buckled boots. She does this in two timed parts. From 0 to 1.2 seconds: dizzy, she wobbles, her knees give way and she topples backward until she is flat on her back, exactly as in <Picture 2>. From 1.2 to 5.2 seconds: she lies there dazed, her head lolling slowly from side to side, and does not move from that spot. She ends in exactly the pose of <Picture 2>. Her expressions and body language stay true to her personality: guarded, blunt and wary like a feral guard dog, but quietly childlike and eager to please; she flinches easily, glares or growls when annoyed, and turns shy and hides in her tall collar when praised. The camera stays completely static throughout, with no zoom or pan, framing her full body from head to feet, and the plain background stays constant and empty. No other characters, objects or scenery appear, and there are no cuts. Show only the character's physical motion and expressions. No visual effects, overlays, particles, motion blur, speed lines, impact marks, text or floating symbols. No shadow on the floor or behind her, and no floor line, wall line or other surface is drawn.
